groundTruth.description: Fixes GHSA-f9vj-2wh5-fj8j / CVE-2024-49766: on Python < 3.11 on Windows, os.path.isabs() does not catch UNC paths like //server/share, so Werkzeug's safe_join() could produce a path that is not actually safe. The fix adds an explicit `filename.startswith("/")` check alongside the existing os.path.isabs() check. A single-line, well-targeted fix with its own updated test coverage (tests/test_security.py).
